sections.heading: Bandwidth ordering
sections.text: Inner current loop crossover: f_ci ~ fsw/10. Outer voltage loop crossover: f_cv ~ f_ci/5 to f_ci/3. Same bandwidth ordering as forward converter. The current loop handles the primary-side inductor dynamics.

sections.heading: Gain direction
sections.text: For the current loop: increase kp until the primary current tracks within one switching cycle. For the voltage loop: increase kp for transient response, increase ki for steady-state accuracy. Full-bridge allows higher duty cycle than forward, so the gain range is wider.

sections.heading: Slope compensation
sections.text: Full-bridge can operate at D > 0.5, so slope compensation is mandatory. Ramp slope >= inductor downslope / 2. The slope compensation affects the current-loop gain — account for it in the loop design.

sections.heading: Operating-point sensitivity
sections.text: The plant gain varies with input voltage and load. At light load, the LC filter is more resonant (higher Q). Verify voltage-loop stability at both full load and light load. At Vin_max, the duty cycle is smallest and the current-loop gain is lowest.
